rules.says: A task notification, a scheduled message and an agent's hand-back are not messages from the owner, so they neither count as a go-word nor as a correction.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.says: A message from the owner that the harness never delivered is printed once, word for word, at the top of the turn of the prompt that overtook it, and the session answers it there.

rules.says: A message the queue loses stops being held against every call once a message typed after it has arrived as a prompt, so the hold must not persist for the rest of the session or wait for the same words to be resent.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The talk is checked against the

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A plan mode entered after the approval, the

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A finished plan holds nothing against
rules.says: A finished plan holds nothing against the next one: once every step in the Order has a hand-back opening DONE, or the plan is closed by a manager's Done line for each non-DONE step, or ejected by an Eject note naming its file, a later plan mode is the owner's and the next plan's write passes.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **The plan mode the harness brings back after an approval, for every actor.**
rules.says: When a container restart brings plan mode back to the main thread and agents while the approval marker still matches the plan file, the main thread's calls are judged as outside plan mode: plan-guard passes the plan's other calls and approved-plan-guard judges them as calls made outside plan mode.

rules.heading: The plan mode the harness brings back after an approval, for every actor

rules.says: For the main thread and for every agent sent after a restart, whether a restored plan mode is in force is decided by the one question restartedPlanMode, and what holds for each actor is stated once on this page and run once in session-guards.test.mjs.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Its approval call is refused as already approved (`APPROVED_NO_LATCH`,
rules.says: After a restored plan mode the main thread's approval call is refused as already approved, but passes on a go-word the owner types after the restore.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The marker is recovered from the transcript's approved exit

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **The plan is checked whole before the talk turn.** `node

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.

rules.heading: The plan is checked whole before the talk turn
rules.quote: The approval call itself still stops at the first fault, and a fault of the plan's shape sets no latch (rule 14)
rules.says: The ExitPlanMode approval call itself stops at the first fault it finds, and a fault of the plan's shape sets no latch, which is why the whole-plan check is run first.

rules.quote: A title the third-person check refuses

rules.quote: a

rules.quote: A writer is read from each step's
